provenance.Message:
pci, drivers: avoid 32-bit access to Command Register

The Command Register in PCI configuration space is 16 bits wide, while
the upper 16 bits at offset 0x06 contain the Status Register.
Performing a 32-bit access to offset 0x04 writes back the Status
Register, which can inadvertently clear Write-1-to-Clear (W1C) status
bits.

This patch updates pci_enable_device() to use 16-bit values,
introduces pci_disable_device(), and updates drivers to avoid 32-bit
accesses to the Command Register.
